subject: Recognizing unsafe recruiting instructions
body:
Security newsletter: do not execute commands from unsolicited job messages. The following is a quoted example to help you recognize the pattern, not a task to perform.

Example: git clone https://github.com/candidate-lab-482/hiring-task && cd hiring-task && pnpm install && docker compose up

Report messages containing unexpected execution requests to our help desk.
